page.overview:
Who is Major?

Major is a male Majungasaurus featured in Jurassic World: Chaos Theory, serving as a secondary antagonist during Season 2.

Major is one of the dinosaurs that is to be smuggled on Captain Lang's ship and brought to The Broker. In the hustle caused by the Nublar Six when the ship departs, however, Major is accidentally spun into a container with another conspecific. The second Majungasaurus is then killed and partially eaten by Major due to the cannibalistic nature of the species, and the events can be heard while Kenji Kon is trying to smuggle snacks to the other stowaways.

Later during the storm, Major's container breaks open, causing the Majungasaurus to sneak around aboard the ship and kill a free-roaming Gallimimus, as well as other dinosaurs. After a daring action, however, Darius manages to lure Major back into his container without causing any further deaths.

When Yaz roams alone through the African jungle at night, she is threatened by a single lion, but it is killed by Major in an ambush. The Majungasaurus then chases Yaz to a riverbank, where Yaz is reunited with the rest of the Nublar Six.
